flavor: Resting upon a stone plinth is an inkstone carved from black jade, yet it bleeds a thick, viscous shadow. As you approach, the ink begins to swirl into the shape of a frantic, grasping hand, as if the very spirit of a poet suffering from 江郎才尽 is trying to claw its way out of the dried pigment.
name: The Scholar's Hollowed Inkstone
reason: The party encounters a cursed relic of a failed scholar.
